title: Image Refs Serverless — Qwen-Image-Edit 2511 compose
description: ComfyUI serverless worker for the first-frame-by-reference flow: Qwen-Image-Edit 2511 compose/identity/clean only (Apache-2.0). Executes a prepared ComfyUI API graph built by the video_gen catalog, accepts style/location/character references and base/mask assets, and returns the PNG plus execution-fact telemetry (GPU, seconds, size, model, seed, steps, cfg, sampler, scheduler). The manifest ships only the three pinned Qwen-Image-Edit 2511 files (~30.16 GB); t2i models are out of scope. Designed to reuse the existing image-serverless network volume.

input.name: Auto-download models
input.description: Download the three pinned Qwen-Image-Edit 2511 files to the attached network volume at worker boot. On a warm image-serverless volume nothing is downloaded; only the metadata is checked.

input.name: Volume verification mode
input.description: fast (default) — trust the recorded size+mtime in models/.populate-state.tsv, so a warm cold start is seconds instead of reading 30.16 GB; full — read sha256 of every manifest file before the handler starts; off — skip the check (debug only).

input.name: Background sha256 verification
input.description: After the handler starts, verify the three manifest files against their pinned sha256 in the background ([populate-verify] in the log). Disable for latency-critical sessions; the volume is still verified when metadata changes.

input.name: Hugging Face token
input.description: Optional — only needed if the public Qwen repositories in models-manifest.txt are replaced with gated mirrors.

input.name: Job timeout (seconds)
input.description: Maximum time a single image job may run before the worker aborts it. Must be less than or equal to the endpoint timeout (1200 s recommended for compose).

input.name: ComfyUI boot timeout (seconds)
input.description: How long the worker waits for the local ComfyUI server to become ready.

input.name: Use custom nodes from the volume
input.description: Symlink custom_nodes from /runpod-volume/custom_nodes into ComfyUI. Leave disabled: the refs profile is core ComfyUI only and the image starts with --disable-all-custom-nodes.

input.name: S3 endpoint
input.description: Optional S3/MinIO endpoint. Configure S3_* to return large images as presigned image_url instead of inline base64.

input.name: S3 access key
input.description: S3/MinIO access key (secret — endpoint env only).

input.name: S3 secret key
input.description: S3/MinIO secret key (secret — endpoint env only).

input.name: S3 bucket
input.description: Bucket for large image output (alias: OUTPUT_BUCKET).

changelog:
## v1.0.0

- Initial refs profile: dedicated image worker for the first-frame-by-reference flow (Qwen-Image-Edit 2511 compose/identity/clean).
- Manifest trimmed to the three pinned files of the model (~30.16 GB); FLUX.2 klein 4B and Qwen-Image-2512 (t2i) are out of scope and not in the manifest. The existing image-serverless network volume can be reused: populate checks only these rows, ComfyUI still sees the other files through extra_model_paths.yaml (unverified here).
- Image diet: the baked `/opt/comfyui-baked` copy and the base pod custom nodes (ComfyUI-Manager, ComfyUI-KJNodes, Civicomfy, ComfyUI-RunpodDirect) are removed at build time; ComfyUI starts with `--disable-all-custom-nodes --disable-metadata`. No ComfyUI-Manager network tasks on boot, no custom-node imports.
- Worker code, handler and contract `image-serverless/v1` are unchanged: the worker still executes the prepared ComfyUI API graph and returns measured telemetry.
- Recommended endpoint: QUEUE, 48 GB (AMPERE_48/ADA_48_PRO), max=1, idleTimeout 300–600, timeout 1200 s, `RUNPOD_INIT_TIMEOUT=1800`. Warm worker (or pre-warm) is the real first-frame latency lever; the cold first job still stages ~30 GB.
- Quality: the Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 model card uses 40 steps; compose runs 20 steps (already half), draft 10. 15 steps only after a live A/B on faces/hands/text/geometry — the first frame is fed to H3, so its degradation carries into the video.
